0002_seed_programmes.sql.summary: Seeds the programme catalogue. ON CONFLICT(slug) DO UPDATE overwrites existing programme rows (names, prices, durations) with the values in the file.
0002_seed_programmes.sql.ownerDecision: If this migration is still pending in production, applying it would overwrite any existing programme rows, including prices, with the values from when it was written. Prices must not change without the owner's approval: compare the programmes table with lib/config.ts first.

0004_admissions.sql.summary: Adds admissions tables and instructor verification columns; UPDATE marks every instructor existing at that moment as verification = 'approved' (line 51).
0004_admissions.sql.ownerDecision: If pending in production, every instructor account present at the moment it runs becomes 'approved' (able to teach). Confirm that every existing instructor account really is an approved, active instructor before approving.

0005_identity.sql.summary: Adds staff_no and email_prefs columns and numbers existing administrators and approved instructors in creation order (UPDATE ... WHERE on the new, empty staff_no column only). No existing value is overwritten.

0006_instructor_profile.sql.summary: Adds instructor profile columns; fills the new verified_at column from created_at for already-approved instructors (UPDATE ... WHERE on a new column only). No existing value is overwritten.

0007_refinement.sql.summary: Adds the AI Automation programme row and new tables. The programme INSERT uses ON CONFLICT(slug) DO UPDATE, which would overwrite an existing 'ai-automation' row's name, price and durations.
0007_refinement.sql.ownerDecision: If pending in production and an 'ai-automation' programme row already exists, its price (NGN 300,000 in the file) and durations would be overwritten. Confirm the intended price with the owner before approving.

0011_catalogue.sql.reviewedBy: Claude (Expansion Stage B engineering review, 27 Nov 2026)
0011_catalogue.sql.summary: Additive catalogue migration: new tables schools and programme_drafts (seeded with the 6 schools and 21 unpublished 2027 drafts; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, nothing overwritten), new columns on programmes and enrolments. UPDATEs write only the NEW columns of the nine live programme rows (display text, order) and fill the new enrolment duration snapshot from current programme durations; one UPDATE clears Cloud Engineering's was_kobo (crossed-out NGN 700,000 seeded by 0002, never shown on the live website). No price or duration of a live programme changes.
0011_catalogue.sql.ownerDecision: Before applying in production: (1) confirm Cloud Engineering should have no crossed-out price (the live website shows none; the database row from 0002 has NGN 700,000); (2) confirm existing enrolments should keep their current durations as a permanent snapshot. Stage B authorises local and staging only.

0016_approval_execution.sql.summary: Adds execution columns to approval_requests. The two UPDATEs touch only approved requests on the new column (still 'not_applicable'): executed_at set -> 'completed', otherwise 'failed'. 0015 was never applied in production, so production has no rows to change. No existing value is overwritten and no access is granted.
